design.activity: android.app.NativeActivity, no Java code; CAndroidNative's ANativeActivity_onCreate (C) hands over to Swift on the process main thread
design.main queue: libdispatch's _dispatch_get_main_queue_handle_4CF eventfd added to the main thread's ALooper; each wake reads the eventfd and calls _dispatch_main_queue_callback_4CF, so the runtime's main actor and DispatchQueue.main run on the Android main thread (SDL3's Android glue runs the game on its own thread, where the main-actor checks would trap)
design.data: the resource bundle and the packaged music ship as APK assets (assets/ntsd + files.txt) and are extracted to files/ntsd-data on a background thread once (marker = files.txt); the session gets --resources
design.screen: the surface in dp (pixels / (density/160)); frames go to the ANativeWindow letterboxed into the surface aspect, B,G,R,X swizzled to RGBX
design.input: AInputQueue on the main looper; Android key codes -> HID usages -> OriginalHIDKeys (Back acts as Escape; characters for letters, digits and space only, declared); touch through OriginalRuntimeTouchMouse
design.first-step stand-ins (declared): no text rasteriser (TextOutA draws nothing, as the headless host), silent music by manifest duration, no sound output
design.harness: files/args.txt adds session options (written with run-as); --events-file; --tz sets TZ (an app inherits the zygote's environment)

apk: tools/crossplatform/android_app.py: libNTSDAndroid.so (static Swift runtime) + NDK r30 libc++_shared.so, aapt2 link (debuggable, hasCode=false, sensorLandscape), zipalign, apksigner with a local debug key; 220 MB

findings.time zone: first vs run: state equal except dates and the recording name one hour earlier (TZ not inherited); --tz fixed it
findings.taps: on the emulator a tap on START did nothing: the host (like the iPad host) reported the cursor at 0,0, and a tap's press and release arrived together while the original reads GetCursorPos and the held button across game ticks; fixed in edccfde for both hosts (cursor = last touch; OriginalRuntimeTouchMouse: move, press after 80 ms, hold at least 150 ms)

results.frames: all 1,832 frames identical to the linux-headless matrix run
results.interactive (emulator screenshots): the main menu shows letterboxed on the 2560x1600 tablet; after the touch fix one tap on START opens the loading screen
